stories.title: Welsh Rates of Income Tax HMRC Annual Report 2026 Published
stories.summary: HMRC has published its annual report on Welsh Rates of Income Tax, covering the UK Government's provisions enabling the Welsh Government to set Property Income rates in line with current Income Tax powers.

stories.title: Scottish Income Tax HMRC Annual Report 2026 Released
stories.summary: HMRC released its Scottish Income Tax annual report for 2026, including findings from an exploration into calculating a Scotland-specific Income Tax Gap.

stories.title: 500 New Officers in £500 Million Anti-Money Laundering Crackdown
stories.summary: The Home Office announced the recruitment of 500 new officers as part of a £500 million Anti-Money Laundering and Asset Recovery initiative, targeting financial crime across the UK.

stories.title: UK Paying £56,000 Per Person Returned to France
stories.summary: Reports reveal the UK is spending approximately £56,000 for each individual returned to France under immigration enforcement arrangements, raising questions about cost-effectiveness of returns policy.

stories.title: G7 Statement on Bab al-Mandab and Navigational Rights and Freedoms
stories.summary: The FCDO joined G7 partners in publishing a joint statement on the Bab al-Mandab strait, reaffirming commitments to navigational rights and freedom of the seas amid ongoing regional security concerns.

stories.title: UK PM Drives Global AI Work at UNGA; UK-US AI and Autonomy Partnership Announced
stories.summary: At the UN General Assembly, the Prime Minister announced the launch of a new UK-US AI and Autonomy partnership, signalling deepened bilateral cooperation on emerging defence and technology frameworks.

stories.title: Benefit Cap Statistics: Households Capped to May 2026 Published
stories.summary: The Department for Work and Pensions released its quarterly statistics publication on the number of households affected by the benefit cap on Universal Credit up to May 2026.

stories.title: New Roadmap for Cleaner Coastal Waters: From Catchment to Coral Reef
stories.summary: A new Defra-supported roadmap developed through Cefas sets out collaborative approaches to improving coastal water quality, addressing pollution from catchment to marine environments.

stories.title: UK-Philippines JETC Joint Statement Highlights DEFRA Collaboration
stories.summary: The joint statement from the UK-Philippines Joint Economic and Trade Committee highlighted DEFRA cooperation on precision breeding, anti-microbial resistance, fisheries, and food safety capacity building.

stories.title: UK Military Support to Saudi Arabia Detailed
stories.summary: The MoD published details of current UK military support arrangements with the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, providing transparency on bilateral defence cooperation.

stories.title: Over 114,000 Army Applicants Rejected on Medical Grounds in Five Years
stories.summary: MoD data revealed that more than 114,000 applications to the British Army were rejected on medical grounds over the past five years, raising concerns about recruitment capacity and health screening criteria.

stories.title: MoD Awards Contract for 9,000 Vehicles to Replace Ageing Land Rover Fleet
stories.summary: The MoD has awarded a contract to supply 9,000 military vehicles over five to seven years to replace the Army's ageing Land Rover-based fleet, with implications for UK and European defence supply chains.

agencies.name: BIST
agencies.description: Department for Business, Innovation, Science and Trade

stories.title: ASEAN-UK Economic Partnership: Joint Media Statement and Declaration
stories.summary: BIST Minister Lord Sarwar and ASEAN Economic Ministers endorsed a new Joint Ministerial Declaration and Economic Partnership, marking a significant step in UK-ASEAN trade and economic cooperation.

stories.title: UK Parliament to Tighten AI Regulations; Major Tech Companies Summoned
stories.summary: The UK Parliament is preparing a broad review of AI safety, inviting Meta, Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic to participate in a major hearing, signalling tougher regulatory scrutiny of AI companies operating in the UK.

stories.title: UK National Statement at 70th IAEA General Conference
stories.summary: Minister Michael Shanks delivered the UK's national statement at the International Atomic Energy Agency's 70th General Conference, outlining the UK's position on nuclear energy, safety and non-proliferation.

stories.title: Nottingham NHS Trust Blames 'Human Error' for New Baby Data Loss
stories.summary: A Nottingham NHS trust has admitted that 'human error' was responsible for the loss of data relating to newborn babies, prompting concerns about data governance and patient safety in NHS digital systems.

stories.title: Free Mobile Devices Scheme Helps Patients in Sunderland and South Tyneside
stories.summary: A new NHS scheme is providing refurbished mobile devices to patients who need them most in Sunderland and South Tyneside, aiming to improve health outcomes through digital access.

stories.title: Imperial College Healthcare Shortlisted for Three Health Tech Awards
stories.summary: Imperial College Healthcare NHS Trust has been shortlisted as a finalist in three Health Tech Award categories, recognising digital innovation in outpatient utilisation and visibility.
